title: Lock starter runtime, service, port, and environment contract
description: Make the generated local runtime interface exact before individual component templates are implemented.
design: Use Compose service names web, api, and database; default host ports 3000, 8080, and 5432; overridable environment values; a normalized workspace-derived Compose project name; API health at /healthz and readiness at /readyz; database health through pg_isready. Generate only .env.example, ignore .env, and define useful failures for occupied ports or missing Podman and Compose prerequisites. API-only and Database-only selections remain valid.
acceptance_criteria: The reviewed contract names every service, port, environment input, health endpoint, dependency rule, and failure mode; generated configuration contains no credentials; selection-specific Compose output is deterministic; port overrides work; occupied default ports fail with actionable output.
notes: P0 implementation contract. No remote CI or application-domain behavior. Reopened for final preflight guard: empty and Mobile-only selections must not require OCI prerequisites; close after focused regression and full verification.

title: Lock generated-workspace provenance and ownership contract
description: Define deterministic generator provenance and one-shot ownership rules before starter templates or module metadata are implemented.
design: Require generated version-1 configurations to record tool=smt, the SMT version, and the template-set version without timestamps or machine-specific values. Workspace generation remains deterministic and offline. Apply must refuse an existing destination before mutation; v0.1.0 does not regenerate, merge, or upgrade application files.
acceptance_criteria: New blueprints contain exact deterministic provenance; unsupported or missing provenance fails clearly before mutation; applying into an existing destination leaves it unchanged; repeat generation to fresh destinations is byte-stable; no upgrade or extend executor is introduced.
notes: P0 contract gate. This is the ownership boundary for all generated starters and the future module catalog.

title: Generate runnable Podman-first starter components
description: Replace README-only selected component output with a domain-neutral runnable starter that helps users build applications quickly while preserving deterministic offline workspace generation.
design: Generate reviewed locked templates for Next.js Web, Go API, PostgreSQL 18, and Flutter Mobile. Web and API use non-root Containerfiles; Database runs through the official PostgreSQL image; Mobile remains Android/iOS rather than an OCI runtime. Generate conditional compose.yaml, environment example, health/readiness, graceful shutdown, API-owned migration and pgx integration when Database is selected, plus Podman-first build/up/down/smoke commands. Apply copies assets but never invokes npm, Flutter, Podman, Compose, or provider APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Web-only, API-only, API-plus-Database, all-component, Database-only, and Mobile-only blueprints generate valid deterministic output; Podman Compose builds and starts selected OCI services; health/readiness and database connectivity pass; Mobile source analyzes and tests on the pinned Flutter toolchain; no secrets or registry auth are committed; focused and real-workspace tests pass.
notes:
P0 user-value milestone. No fake CRUD domain and no smt extend.
Approved runtime baseline: Go 1.26.5; pgx v5.10.0; Next.js 16.2.9 on Node 24.18.0; Flutter 3.44.9; PostgreSQL 18; Podman 5.8.3 or newer with a Compose provider.
Rollup: do not close until smt-4xf.3.1 through smt-4xf.3.6 are accepted. Child completion is the rollup closure gate; keep parent-child hierarchy for scheduling, but do not add reverse blocker edges from this rollup to its descendants.

title: Rewrite version 1 module taxonomy and configuration
description: Rewrite the version-1 blueprint and configuration contract around explicit component and capability boundaries. Remove the broad DevOps selection before runnable starter work begins.
design: Remove the DevOps prompt, workspace.stack.devops, the infra repository, docker-opentofu component validation, and generated DevOps artifacts. Keep Web, Mobile, API, and Database as the basic independent submodules. Reject obsolete DevOps-shaped version-1 input with a clear migration error. Preserve credential-free remotes, Git safety, and existing lifecycle ordering.
acceptance_criteria: New blueprints and apply validation contain no DevOps bundle; exact Web, Mobile, API, and Database selections remain supported; obsolete DevOps configurations fail clearly before mutation; focused config, blueprint, apply, and CLI tests pass; docs match the accepted contract.
notes: P0 implementation foundation. smt extend is out of scope.

title: Restructure SMT modules and runnable version 1
description: Replace the broad DevOps bundle with a five-layer module architecture and make version 1 generate a runnable Podman-first starter workspace. This epic intentionally excludes the smt extend command, which is tracked separately for later delivery.
design: Keep one SMT repository initially. Preserve independent component submodules. Rewrite version 1 because there are no external users: remove workspace.stack.devops and the infra repository; retain Web, Mobile, API, and Database; add container, cicd, observability, iac, k8s, and argocd as explicit capability boundaries. Podman is the default local OCI engine. Kubernetes, ArgoCD, AWS, Apptainer, and OpenTofu execution remain optional follow-on capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Approved design and roadmap are committed to canonical docs; ordered implementation and human-review children are complete; version 1 no longer emits the DevOps bundle; runnable starter and security gates pass; the existing tagged GitHub release path is ready for v0.1.0; extend remains outside this epic.
notes:
Priority P0: module restructuring and the runnable starter are the current focus. Do not implement smt extend under this epic.
Granular delivery breakdown added on 2026-08-17: provenance and runtime contracts are P0; component slices, local verification, security, runtime matrices, human acceptance, and release notes are ordered P1 work. Remote CI, managed upgrades, full observability, SBOM and signing, load testing, and smt extend remain outside this epic.

title: Modernize the public README with source-first onboarding
description: Replace the root README runbook-style landing page with a modern, visitor-oriented project overview that explains SMT quickly, provides a verified build-from-source path, distinguishes current features from planned work, and links operational detail to canonical docs.
design: Use a concise centered hero with honest development, Go, and MIT badges; a problem/value introduction; current-feature overview; source-first Getting Started; a compact blueprint-to-workspace Mermaid flow; explicit Now, Next, and Later roadmap; safety principles; documentation, contributing, and license links. Keep current behavior separate from planned module restructure and smt extend. Move detailed hook collision and lifecycle explanations behind existing documentation links rather than deleting their durable source.
acceptance_criteria: README is materially easier to scan; build-from-source commands are executable from a fresh clone; current features and roadmap are visibly separated; Mermaid and links are valid; no unsupported installation, release, or feature claim appears; canonical command recipes, implementation spec, product concept, module design, production plan, toolchain contract, contributing guidance, and MIT license are discoverable; markdown, placeholder, link, and repository checks pass.
notes:
Approved source-first public landing-page design. Create on a new branch from main. Documentation only; do not alter CLI behavior or install dependencies.
Implemented the approved modern public README on branch smt-4xf.12. Added a source-first Getting Started path, current feature table, compact Mermaid workflow, explicit Now/Next/Later roadmap, safety principles, canonical docs, contributing workflow, and MIT license. Added active design and implementation-plan notes. Validation passed: git diff --check, placeholder scan, 10 repository link targets, task build, bin/smt --help, task verify outside the sandbox, bd dependency cycles, bd lint, and bd orphans. The sandboxed build emitted a non-fatal Go stat-cache permission warning but exited successfully. No CLI code, package installation, commit, or push was performed.
Reopened for commit and remote review because the repository hook requires the exact active Beads task as the branch name. Keep in progress until the pushed branch is accepted.

title: Generate root aggregate verification tasks
description: Coordinate only the selected component Taskfiles and local Podman lifecycle from the generated workspace root.
design: Generate root format:check, lint, test, build, smoke, security, and verify tasks that dispatch to selected repositories in deterministic order. Include Podman Compose lifecycle and non-root checks when OCI components exist, Beads-aware guidance, and Gitleaks security verification. Do not install tools or emit remote CI.
acceptance_criteria: Every component selection has a valid root Taskfile; aggregate tasks call only selected repositories; component failures preserve actionable output; OCI smoke and non-root checks run only when relevant; no provider token, remote workflow YAML, package installation, or host configuration mutation occurs.
notes: Terminal child that gates the local verification Taskfile rollup.

title: Generate the Mobile repository Taskfile
description: Expose Flutter package, quality, test, and debug-build gates through a repeatable local interface.
design: Generate deps, format:check, format:write, analyze, test, test:integration, build:android:debug, build:ios:debug, and verify tasks. Dependency resolution is explicit rather than part of smt apply. Platform- or device-dependent tasks report precise prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: Task commands map to the generated pubspec and Flutter SDK; verify runs all host-supported non-interactive gates; unsupported iOS or missing-device lanes remain explicit; no MCP server, skill installation, signing, or store publishing is performed.
notes: Component Taskfile child; Flutter MCP remains opt-in.

title: Generate API and Database repository Taskfiles
description: Expose built-in Go gates, pinned Go tools, OpenAPI, and conditional database workflows through local tasks.
design: Generate API tasks for format:check, vet, test, race, coverage, fuzz, lint, vuln, build, openapi, and verify. When Database is selected, add migrate:up, migrate:version, and integration tasks; generate Database readiness and diagnostic tasks without destructive migration commands. Never install Go tools implicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks invoke SDK commands or go.mod-pinned tools; selection-specific tasks appear only when valid; OpenAPI drift, module drift, lint, vulnerability, tests, and migration failures block verify; no down, drop, force, credential, or remote CI behavior is generated.
notes: Combined because the API owns migrations while Database owns runtime readiness.

title: Generate the Web repository Taskfile
description: Expose the generated Web manifest scripts through one provider-neutral local quality interface.
design: Generate format:check, format:write, lint, typecheck, test, build, test:e2e, and verify tasks that call package.json scripts and never install dependencies implicitly. Verify uses the committed lockfile and reports missing Node or dependencies clearly.
acceptance_criteria: Every Web task maps to a declared package script; task verify is non-mutating after dependencies exist; missing prerequisites fail clearly; no GitHub, GitLab, browser login, token, or provider workflow is generated.
notes: Component Taskfile child; remote CI remains deferred.

title: Generate and verify Flutter unit, widget, and integration suites
description: Provide checked-in verification for the generated Mobile starter and its platform debug builds.
design: Generate focused Dart unit tests, Flutter widget smoke tests, and an integration_test flow using stable keys. Run dart format check, flutter analyze, unit and widget tests, integration tests on an available target, and Android and iOS debug builds. Treat device-specific live UI driving and Dart MCP as optional human or agent lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Format, analyze, unit, widget, integration, and supported debug-build gates pass; missing device or unavailable host platform is reported as an explicit unverified lane rather than silently passing; no device farm, signing, MCP, or store workflow is required.
notes: Terminal child that gates the Mobile starter rollup.

title: Generate runnable Flutter source and platform assets
description: Generate the domain-neutral application source and Android and iOS project assets after the manifest is fixed.
design: Generate a minimal navigable Flutter application with environment-safe API base URL handling, no required API dependency, stable widget keys for testing, Android and iOS debug project assets, and no store publication or signing configuration. Keep Mobile outside Compose and OCI packaging.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile-only source runs and compiles on the pinned Flutter toolchain; API configuration is optional and contains no secret; Android and iOS project metadata is deterministic; no fake CRUD, generated signing material, or OCI service exists.
notes: Depends on the pinned Flutter manifest.

title: Generate pinned Flutter manifest and analysis policy
description: Generate pubspec.yaml, pubspec.lock, and analysis_options.yaml for the Mobile starter.
design: Pin the Flutter 3.44.9 compatible dependency set. Put flutter_test and integration_test SDK packages plus flutter_lints in dev_dependencies. Use SDK-provided dart format, flutter analyze, build commands, and DevTools without adding them as packages. Flutter agent skills and Dart MCP remain external opt-in developer capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile generation emits deterministic pubspec.yaml, pubspec.lock, and analysis policy; flutter pub get later preserves the committed lockfile; dependency and SDK roles are correct; no MCP server, agent skill, signing secret, or host SDK is represented as an application package.
notes: Manifest-first child of the Mobile starter rollup.

title: Verify database-only and API plus Database lifecycles
description: Exercise the generated database and conditional API integration without depending on the later full Compose matrix.
design: Use disposable Podman-backed PostgreSQL instances to verify readiness, migration up and version, pgx connectivity and pooling, API readiness reflection, no-change behavior, failure reporting, and cleanup. Preserve diagnostic state after a failed migration rather than attempting destructive repair.
acceptance_criteria: Database-only and API plus Database component tests pass on the pinned runtime; pgx integration uses real PostgreSQL; failure cases are actionable and non-destructive; disposable resources are cleaned after successful runs; secrets and machine-specific state are not persisted.
notes: Terminal child that gates the Database starter rollup.

title: Generate API-owned migration assets and explicit commands
description: Add the safe schema migration path only when API and Database are selected.
design: Generate ordered SQL migrations in the API repository and use the migrate tool pinned by the API go.mod. Expose migrate up and version commands; never run migrations during API startup or smt apply; never generate automatic down, drop, force, or destructive recovery tasks.
acceptance_criteria: API plus Database output contains deterministic migration assets and selection-correct tool metadata; up, version, and no-change paths pass; locked, dirty, or invalid states fail loudly; API-only and Database-only output contains no invalid migration command.
notes: Operator-owned migration child; no automatic mutation.

title: Generate PostgreSQL runtime and readiness assets
description: Generate the Database-only operational assets independently from the API repository.
design: Use the PostgreSQL 18 image with environment placeholders, persistent local volume declaration, pg_isready health checks, fail-fast psql diagnostics, and no embedded credentials. Database-only selection starts an empty healthy database and does not generate API-owned schema or migration tools.
acceptance_criteria: Database-only output is deterministic; the container becomes healthy through pg_isready; psql diagnostics fail clearly; stop and restart preserve expected local data; generated files contain examples only and no credential values.
notes: First child of the Database starter rollup.

title: Package and verify the non-root API runtime
description: Prove the generated API can be built and operated as a safe local OCI service.
design: Generate a multi-stage Containerfile with a minimal non-root runtime, explicit port and environment contract, health and readiness behavior, and graceful stop handling. Run module verification, lint, vulnerability, OpenAPI drift, binary build, image build, identity, endpoint, and shutdown checks on the pinned toolchain.
acceptance_criteria: The API binary and image build reproducibly; govulncheck and golangci-lint pass using pinned tools; the container runs non-root; health, readiness, request IDs, OpenAPI, and shutdown pass; no build cache, module cache, or credentials are committed.
notes: Terminal child that gates the API starter rollup.

title: Generate API unit, race, fuzz, and integration test suites
description: Provide expert Go verification coverage for the generated API and its conditional database adapter.
design: Generate table-driven unit tests for handlers and configuration, lifecycle tests for health and readiness, request ID assertions, a focused fuzz target for input or configuration parsing, race-safe shutdown coverage, and pgx integration tests that activate only in API plus Database verification. Use standard Go testing; do not add a third-party test framework.
acceptance_criteria: go test, race, coverage, and focused fuzz commands have deterministic targets; API-only tests need no database; conditional pgx tests fail clearly when their disposable database is unavailable and pass in the owning integration lane; no network service is silently required by unit tests.
notes: Test-suite child of the API starter rollup.

title: Generate pinned API module and Go tool manifest
description: Generate selection-aware go.mod and go.sum assets that separate runtime libraries from repository-scoped developer tools.
design: Pin Go 1.26.5 and Huma v2.39.1; include pgx v5.10.0 and golang-migrate v4.19.1 only for API plus Database. Use Go tool directives to pin govulncheck and golangci-lint v2, plus migrate when Database is selected. gofmt, go vet, go test, race, coverage, and fuzzing are SDK commands and are not module dependencies. Godex and gopls remain agent or editor prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: API-only and API plus Database variants emit deterministic go.mod and go.sum files; runtime and tool dependencies are selection-correct and version-pinned; go mod verify and go mod tidy checks pass later without changing committed files; smt apply performs no download or tool installation.
notes: Manifest-first child of the API starter rollup.

title: Generate the Huma API runtime and OpenAPI assets
description: Generate the typed operational API source after its module contract is fixed.
design: Use Huma over http.ServeMux with health, readiness, docs, and OpenAPI endpoints; structured logs, request IDs, explicit configuration, and graceful shutdown. Generate deterministic OpenAPI 3.1 through a local Go command without starting the server. Keep API-only output independent of PostgreSQL.
acceptance_criteria: Generated API compiles; endpoints and lifecycle behavior pass focused tests; OpenAPI regeneration matches the committed artifact byte-for-byte; API-only mode has no pgx or migration code path; no credentials or domain-specific CRUD are generated.
notes: Depends on the pinned API manifest.

title: Generate and verify the runnable Web runtime slice
description: Complete the Web starter with operational source, health behavior, non-root packaging, and lifecycle evidence.
design: Generate the domain-neutral Next.js landing route and health endpoint, environment-safe API base URL handling, graceful process behavior, and a non-root multi-stage Containerfile. Verify npm ci, quality scripts, production build/start, Playwright smoke, container health, shutdown, and deterministic regeneration.
acceptance_criteria: Web-only output installs from the committed lockfile; format, lint, typecheck, unit tests, build, start, Playwright, non-root container health, and clean shutdown pass; repeated fresh generation is byte-stable; no secrets or fake CRUD are present.
notes: Terminal child that gates the Web starter rollup.

title: Generate Web quality configs, scripts, and smoke suites
description: Make every declared Web development dependency usable through checked-in configuration and package scripts.
design: Generate flat ESLint configuration using eslint-config-next core-web-vitals and TypeScript guidance; separate Prettier check and write; preserve strict TypeScript validation; configure Vitest with jsdom and React Testing Library setup; configure Playwright against a built and started app. Provide scripts for format:check, format:write, lint with zero warnings, typecheck, test, build, start, and test:e2e.
acceptance_criteria: Every package script resolves only declared dependencies; lint warnings fail; formatting checks do not mutate; typecheck, unit tests, and E2E configuration have focused smoke coverage; configuration contains no fake domain behavior or machine-specific paths.
notes: Depends on the pinned Web manifest.

title: Generate pinned Web package manifest and lockfile
description: Generate the selection-owned package.json and package-lock.json for the Next.js Web starter without resolving dependencies during smt apply.
design: Declare Node 24.18.0 and npm metadata; pin Next.js 16.2.9 plus compatible React runtime packages. Put ESLint, eslint-config-next, Prettier, TypeScript and type packages, Vitest, Vite React support, jsdom, React Testing Library, and Playwright in devDependencies. Commit the reviewed npm lockfile as a scaffold asset. Skills, browser tooling, and MCP configuration are not npm dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Web generation emits byte-stable package.json and package-lock.json; dependency roles and versions are explicit; npm ci succeeds later on the pinned toolchain; smt apply performs no network access or install; no agent skill, MCP server, secret, or host-only tool is placed in the manifest.
notes: Manifest-first child of the Web starter rollup.

title: Decompose generated starter manifests and verification tooling
description: Refine the runnable-starter roadmap so each generated component owns an exact package-manager manifest, lockfile, tool configuration, tests, and verification boundary.
design: Keep smt-4xf.3.2, smt-4xf.3.3, smt-4xf.3.5, and smt-4xf.6.1 as rollups. Add ordered, independently reviewable children for manifest and lockfile generation, component behavior, quality configuration and tests, runtime or build verification, and root aggregation. Only code-facing dependencies belong in go.mod, package.json, or pubspec.yaml; SDK built-ins, agent skills, MCP servers, and host tools remain separate prerequisites or optional integrations. smt apply copies pinned assets offline and never resolves or installs dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical docs state the package ownership policy; relevant Beads are expanded into dependency-ordered subtasks with exact manifests, scripts, gates, and boundaries; current roadmap dependencies remain acyclic; bd lint, bd orphans, and git diff checks pass; planning changes are committed and pushed on a dedicated branch.
notes:
Planning and tracker refinement only; no generated starter source or dependencies were implemented or installed.
Completed on branch smt-4xf.11. Added 17 dependency-ordered child issues: Web smt-4xf.3.2.1-.3, API smt-4xf.3.3.1-.4, Database smt-4xf.3.4.1-.3, Mobile smt-4xf.3.5.1-.3, and Taskfiles smt-4xf.6.1.1-.4. Canonical docs define package manifest ownership and keep SDK tools, skills, MCP, and host prerequisites separate. Validation passed: dependency cycle scan, bd lint, bd orphans, git diff --check, placeholder scan, gofmt, go vet, and the full short Go test suite outside the sandbox. golangci-lint was not installed and remains unverified; no packages or tools were installed.
The task remains in progress through PR review because the repository commit hook requires the exact active Beads ID as the branch name.

title: Document component developer toolchains and agent capabilities
description: Research and record the expert local development toolchain, agent skills, and MCP integrations for each v0.1.0 component without claiming those capabilities are already generated.
design: Add one canonical Obsidian-friendly toolchain matrix covering shared workflow rules plus Go API, Next.js Web, Flutter Mobile, PostgreSQL Database, container/runtime, and root integration. Separate native CLI tools, repeatable Taskfile gates, agent skills, and MCP/runtime integrations. Generated workspaces may declare prerequisites and checked-in skill references, but smt apply remains deterministic and offline and never installs host tools, skills, plugins, or MCP configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical design and roadmap docs capture the approved discussion and cited current research; Go uses tests, go vet, govulncheck, golangci-lint, and the Godex skill rather than deprecated golint; Next.js uses direct ESLint CLI, Prettier, typecheck, tests, build, and React/Next skills; Flutter uses format, analyze, tests, builds, official Flutter skills, DevTools, and the Dart and Flutter MCP server as an experimental opt-in; database and shared gates are defined; implemented versus planned status is explicit; link and consistency checks pass.
notes:
Documentation-only execution. Do not implement generated toolchains or install skills/MCP servers in this task.
Completed researched documentation contract and cross-links. Primary sources cover Go security and linting, Next.js 16 lint/test workflow, Flutter official agent skills and experimental Dart/Flutter MCP, and Codex skills/MCP separation. Component implementation and module-contract beads now carry the corresponding gates. Validation: git diff --check, placeholder scan, bd lint, and bd orphans passed; no runtime installation or implementation verification was performed.

title: Prepare v0.1.0 compatibility and limitation notes
description: Document the generated-workspace ownership boundary and accurately separate delivered behavior from deferred roadmap work before tagging.
design: Record the required provenance fields, one-shot no-overwrite policy, supported component matrix, local-only CI interface, migration operator model, reviewed dependency baselines, known limitations, and recovery guidance. Explicitly defer remote CI, managed upgrades, metrics and tracing, SBOM and signing, load testing, extend, cloud, Kubernetes, and ArgoCD execution.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes and canonical docs agree with accepted Beads behavior; no deferred feature is claimed as implemented; generator and template versions are listed; existing generated workspaces are not promised automatic upgrades; human E2E evidence and remaining risks are linked.
notes: Documentation and release-handoff slice; no tag or push authority is implied.

title: Verify the generated runtime in a disposable Linux environment
description: Add repeatable Linux runtime evidence without generating remote provider CI workflows.
design: Use a disposable Linux environment with Podman and a Compose provider to generate representative workspaces, run local verification, build selected images, start the stack, check health and migrations, and cleanly tear it down. Keep this as SMT release validation rather than workflow files copied into user repositories.
acceptance_criteria: Exact Linux commands and versions are recorded; API-plus-Database and all-OCI stacks build, start, become healthy, migrate explicitly, restart, and stop cleanly; local Taskfiles pass; failures preserve useful logs and leave no credential material.
notes: Repeatable release evidence, not remote CI generation.

title: Run human macOS Podman acceptance for the starter matrix
description: Perform the human-owned local runtime gate for the restructured starter on the primary macOS development environment.
design: Use a disposable workspace and the built SMT binary on macOS with Podman machine and Compose. Inspect provenance and topology; run representative generation, local verification, Compose lifecycle, OpenAPI drift, explicit migrations, port overrides, secret hygiene, and retained Git lifecycle commands. Agents may prepare evidence but cannot self-approve this task.
acceptance_criteria: A human records exact commands, tool versions, selected combinations, runtime health, OpenAPI, migration, security, lifecycle, and cleanup evidence; every failure becomes a linked Beads bug; this issue remains open until explicit human approval.
notes: Human gate. Do not close without explicit user authority.

title: Automate generated-workspace selection and lifecycle matrix
description: Prove all supported component combinations and retained SMT lifecycle commands against real generated workspaces.
design: Create disposable workspaces for Web-only, API-only, API-plus-Database, Database-only, Mobile-only, and all-component selections. Verify deterministic apply, provenance, independent Git submodules, local Taskfiles, config validation, hooks, status, doctor, provision planning, push, pull, prepare, switch, and worktree ordering plus failure-safe partial-state reporting.
acceptance_criteria: The full selection matrix and lifecycle regression suite passes; repeat generation to fresh destinations is stable; existing destinations are never overwritten; unsafe paths, symlinks, dirty or detached worktrees, malformed metadata, and partial failures fail before destructive mutation; exact verification evidence is recorded.
notes: Agent-owned automated release gate beneath the hardening rollup.

title: Add practical local supply-chain security gates
description: Make the first-epic security claim measurable without expanding into signing or attestations.
design: Require dependency lockfiles, reviewed pinned base-image versions, non-root Web and API containers, no privileged or no-new-privileges violations, ecosystem dependency vulnerability checks, and a pinned Gitleaks secret scan through local Taskfiles. Examples use placeholders only and real environment files remain ignored.
acceptance_criteria: Security verification passes on clean generated workspaces and fails fixtures containing a secret, missing lockfile, root runtime user, privileged container, or unpinned base-image version; dependency findings are reported without leaking payloads; SBOM, signing, and attestations are not added.
notes: Practical v0.1.0 baseline; deeper provenance work is a later milestone.

title: Generate provider-neutral local verification Taskfiles
description: Give every selected repository a repeatable local quality interface without generating GitHub or GitLab workflows.
design: Expose task lint, task test, and task verify in each generated repository and a root task verify that coordinates selected submodules. The API also exposes task openapi, task migrate:up, and task migrate:version when applicable. Verification uses native ecosystem tools and treats generated OpenAPI drift as a failure.
acceptance_criteria: Every selection has valid Taskfiles; repository-local verify commands run independently; root verification calls only selected repositories; API OpenAPI drift fails verification; migration tasks appear only when valid; no remote workflow YAML or provider token requirement is generated.
notes:
This is local CI only. Remote CI generation is intentionally deferred.
Expanded gate matrix is canonical in docs/10-development/SMT - Component Developer Toolchains.md. Standardize format:check, lint, test, and verify while keeping ecosystem-specific lanes: Web typecheck/build/E2E; API race/coverage/fuzz/vuln/OpenAPI; Mobile analyze/integration/debug builds; Database readiness/migrate up/version/disposable integration; root Podman lifecycle/non-root aggregate verification. Remote CI remains deferred.
Rollup expanded into smt-4xf.6.1.1 through smt-4xf.6.1.4. Component Taskfiles follow accepted starters; the root aggregate is the terminal gate and never installs dependencies or host tooling.

title: Compose selected services and add Podman lifecycle smoke tasks
description: Integrate generated Web, API, and Database services into one conditional Podman-first local runtime.
design: Generate compose.yaml from the selected OCI components only, preserving independent repositories. Provide repeatable build, up, down, logs, and smoke tasks; use health-based dependency ordering; keep Mobile out of Compose; and avoid implicit pulls or runtime execution during SMT apply.
acceptance_criteria: Web-only, API-only, API-plus-Database, Database-only, and all-OCI combinations produce valid Compose files; Podman 5.8.3 or newer with a Compose provider builds and starts them; health, readiness, database connectivity, logs, stop, and restart behavior pass; apply itself remains offline and non-mutating outside the destination.
notes: This task integrates component templates but does not add provider-specific CI.

title: Generate the runnable Flutter Mobile starter
description: Upgrade selected Mobile output from scaffold metadata to a runnable Android and iOS Flutter starter.
design: Generate Flutter 3.44.9 source, lockfile, analysis options, unit and widget smoke tests, Android and iOS project assets, and environment-safe API base URL configuration. Mobile remains outside the OCI Compose runtime and does not require Web, API, or Database.
acceptance_criteria: Mobile-only and all-component generation are deterministic and offline; dependency resolution, analyze, unit and widget tests, and debug builds pass on the pinned toolchain; no signing credentials, generated secrets, or OCI service are introduced.
notes:
Store publication, signing, and device-farm automation remain outside v0.1.0.
Toolchain contract: docs/10-development/SMT - Component Developer Toolchains.md. Verification must cover dart format drift, flutter analyze, unit/widget tests, integration_test, and Android/iOS debug builds. Developer-agent guidance should reference the official flutter/agent-plugins core skills. Dart/Flutter MCP and runtime UI driving are experimental opt-ins; smt apply must not install or configure them.
Rollup expanded into smt-4xf.3.5.1 through smt-4xf.3.5.3. pubspec and analysis policy precede runnable source/platform assets and terminal test/build verification.

title: Generate the Huma Go API and code-first OpenAPI contract
description: Create a runnable typed Go API starter whose source and Go types generate the committed OpenAPI contract.
design: Use Go 1.26.5 and Huma v2.39.1 over the standard http.ServeMux. Provide /healthz, /readyz, /docs, and /openapi.yaml; structured logs, request IDs, graceful shutdown, and a non-root Containerfile. A local generator writes deterministic OpenAPI 3.1 from registered operations and Go types without starting the server.
acceptance_criteria: API-only generation is deterministic and offline; Go tests, vet, build, non-root image build, endpoints, request IDs, graceful shutdown, and OpenAPI 3.1 generation pass; regeneration matches the committed specification byte-for-byte; no database is required in API-only mode.
notes:
Pin Huma at the reviewed v2.39.1 baseline. Full metrics and tracing remain deferred.
Toolchain contract: docs/10-development/SMT - Component Developer Toolchains.md. Verification must cover gofmt drift, go vet ./..., go test ./..., race, coverage, focused fuzzing, govulncheck, pinned golangci-lint v2, OpenAPI drift, and PostgreSQL integration when Database is selected. Use the Godex Go backend skill for implementation/review. golint is deprecated and must not be introduced; no Go MCP is required for v0.1.0.
Rollup expanded into smt-4xf.3.3.1 through smt-4xf.3.3.4. Selection-aware go.mod and tool directives precede Huma/OpenAPI behavior, Go test suites, and terminal non-root runtime verification.

title: Generate PostgreSQL runtime and explicit migration workflow
description: Provide the selected Database runtime and the API-owned schema migration path without coupling migrations to API startup.
design: Use PostgreSQL 18 and pgx v5.10.0. Database-only selection starts an empty healthy database. When API and Database are selected, migrations live in the API repository and use golang-migrate v4.19.1 through task migrate:up and task migrate:version. The API never auto-migrates, and SMT never invokes migrate down, drop, or force.
acceptance_criteria: Database-only and API-plus-Database generation are deterministic; pg_isready and API readiness reflect actual connectivity; migrate up and version pass; no-change is safe; locked or dirty migration state fails loudly; no automatic destructive recovery or committed credentials exist.
notes:
Explicit operator-owned migration boundary chosen for v0.1.0.
Rollup expanded into smt-4xf.3.4.1 through smt-4xf.3.4.3. PostgreSQL readiness precedes conditional API-owned migrations and real database lifecycle verification.

title: Generate the runnable Next.js Web starter
description: Replace the selected Web README shell with a domain-neutral runnable Next.js starter.
design: Generate Next.js 16.2.9 on Node 24.18.0 with a committed lockfile, an operational landing page, a /healthz endpoint, graceful process behavior, and a non-root multi-stage Containerfile. Keep the starter independent when API is absent and do not invent CRUD or domain data.
acceptance_criteria: Web-only generation is deterministic and offline; dependency install, lint, unit tests, production build, non-root image build, container health, and clean shutdown pass on the pinned toolchain; no secrets or fake domain behavior are present.
notes:
Starter implementation slice under the P0 runnable-starter rollup.
Toolchain contract: docs/10-development/SMT - Component Developer Toolchains.md. Implement direct ESLint CLI with --max-warnings=0 (Next 16 removed next lint), separate Prettier check/write, tsc --noEmit, Vitest plus React Testing Library, next build, and Playwright after build/start. Generated output may reference the React best-practices and frontend-testing/debugging skills, but smt apply must not install skills, browser tooling, or dependencies.
Rollup expanded into smt-4xf.3.2.1 through smt-4xf.3.2.3. The manifest and lockfile land first, quality configuration and suites follow, and runtime/container verification is the terminal closure gate.

title: Publish SMT v0.1.0 module-restructure release
description: Publish the accepted module-restructure and runnable-starter release through the existing tag-triggered GitHub archive and checksum workflow.
design: Release only from an approved clean main branch after all automated gates and the human E2E task pass. Build Linux and macOS archives for amd64 and arm64, generate checksums, create the annotated v0.1.0 tag, and let the existing GitHub Actions workflow publish the release. Do not add Homebrew, GitLab release automation, or provider deployment to this task.
acceptance_criteria: The approved v0.1.0 tag exists on origin; the GitHub Release contains all four archives and checksums; checksums verify; release notes accurately bound implemented and deferred behavior; final repository and Beads state are reported.
notes:
P1 release task. Tag and push require explicit release authority and a passed human gate.
Rollup: smt-4xf.8.1 must be accepted before tagging so release notes bound compatibility, ownership, and deferred behavior accurately.

title: Harden and integrate the module restructure
description: Prove the restructured version 1 is safe, scalable at the starter boundary, and integrated with every retained SMT lifecycle command.
design: Ensure status, doctor, hooks, remote provision, push, pull, prepare, switch, worktree, and validation preserve root-plus-submodule ordering and include the restructured repositories. Add negative coverage for secrets, unsafe paths, symlinks, dirty or detached worktrees, invalid branches, malformed module metadata, non-root runtime users, privileged containers, and partial failures. Bound scalability claims to stateless Web/API structure, health/readiness, pooling, configuration, and graceful shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Focused and full Go tests, vet, task verify, task build, govulncheck, generated starter builds/tests, Podman runtime checks, bd lint, and git diff checks pass; no credential or destructive rollback behavior is introduced; canonical docs and CLI help are aligned; any unverified cloud or load behavior is explicitly reported.
notes:
P1 release hardening. Do not broaden into smt extend or cloud deployment.
Rollup: do not close until smt-4xf.6.1 through smt-4xf.6.4 are accepted. Local verification, security, matrix coverage, and disposable Linux runtime evidence are required.

title: Human E2E review of the restructured version 1
description: Human-owned release gate for the complete rewritten blueprint and runnable starter workflow. Agents must not close this task without explicit human authority.
design: Use a disposable workspace and the built SMT binary. Generate and inspect representative component selections, apply the blueprint, verify independent submodules and configuration, build and run the Podman Compose stack, confirm health/readiness/database connectivity and clean shutdown, exercise retained Git lifecycle commands, and inspect secret hygiene and recovery output.
acceptance_criteria: A human records exact commands and evidence for blueprint generation, apply, repository topology, Podman builds and runtime health, Mobile analysis when selected, lifecycle integration, security boundaries, and cleanup. Every failure is linked to a Beads bug and keeps this gate open.
notes:
P1 human gate. Agents may prepare evidence but must not self-approve or close it.
Rollup: smt-4xf.7.1 is the detailed macOS human acceptance checklist. Neither issue may be closed without explicit human authority.

title: Decompose platform and delivery capabilities
description: Replace the old DevOps idea in the architecture and module catalog with explicit capability boundaries that can evolve independently.
design: Model container, cicd, observability, iac, k8s, and argocd separately. Container packaging belongs with runnable application repositories; CI/CD belongs primarily in each repository and consumes shared templates; observability is required at runnable boundaries with an optional shared repository; iac is provider-neutral OpenTofu; k8s is optional and provider-neutral; argocd depends on k8s. AWS, Apptainer, and OpenTofu execution require a later architecture decision selecting a compatible runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Definitions and docs express the six explicit capabilities, their placement defaults, dependency rules, completion criteria, and deferred provider-specific work; no combined DevOps module or repository remains in the new contract; no Kubernetes, ArgoCD, AWS, Apptainer, or OpenTofu runtime is provisioned.
notes: P1 architecture delivery. Implementation must remain bounded to definitions and accepted version-1 behavior.

title: Define the five-layer module contract
description: Establish the declarative module vocabulary needed for future capability growth without adding the smt extend command.
design: Define a thin schema-versioned module contract covering ID, layer/category, provided, required and optional capabilities, repository placement defaults, agent and skill references, verification requirements, and scaffold asset identity. Keep the five layers as Control Plane, Application Components, Shared Infrastructure, Quality and Verification, and Platform and Delivery. Keep the catalog in this repository until lifecycle boundaries justify extraction.
acceptance_criteria: The module schema and validation rules are documented and represented in focused code or embedded definitions as required; duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, cycles, unsafe paths, and unsupported schema versions fail safely; existing component configurations remain unambiguous; no public extend command or mutation executor is introduced.
notes:
P1 foundation for later extensions. This task must not add smt extend.
The module contract must distinguish native prerequisites and verification gates from agent skill references and optional MCP/runtime integrations. Required versus conditional capabilities must be explicit. smt apply may emit checked-in declarations and doctor guidance, but must remain deterministic/offline and must not install host tools, skills, plugins, MCP servers, or host configuration.

title: Document the five-layer SMT module restructure
description: Turn the approved production plan and supplied architecture proposal into durable, Obsidian-friendly project documentation. Clearly separate current implemented behavior from approved module-restructure work and explicitly defer smt extend.
design: Create a focused design note and delivery roadmap, then align the canonical product concept and implementation spec. Preserve existing history and links. Document the five layers, one-repository-first rule, removal of the DevOps bundle, Podman-first runnable starters, decomposed platform capabilities, bounded security and scalability claims, and later AWS, Apptainer, OpenTofu, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and extend work.
acceptance_criteria: Docs have valid frontmatter, stable titles, concise summaries, working relative wikilinks, and no claim that unimplemented behavior exists. The roadmap names Beads as execution state, prioritizes smt-4xf, and marks extend as deferred. Markdown and git diff checks pass.
notes: This task is documentation-only. Do not edit Go code, generated source, Beads state, or Git history.
close_reason: Documented the approved five-layer module restructure, Podman-first v0.1.0 roadmap, fixed runtime baseline, P0 Beads delivery map, and deferred smt extend boundary; frontmatter, wikilinks, placeholder scan, and diff checks passed.

title: Normalize worker agent runtime settings
description: Update every SMT worker manifest and generated worker template to use GPT-5.6 Luna with the priority Fast service tier and xhigh reasoning, then align the canonical agent-team and repository routing documentation and verify all settings.

title: Retire obsolete workflow commands on smt-nvk
description: Keep the smt-nvk branch active while its verified CLI cleanup commit is created and pushed. The branch commit must use the exact Beads ID in its subject.

title: Retire obsolete workflow and developer CLI commands
description: Remove the unused release, review, work, check, ci, contracts, and generated completion CLI surfaces. Keep workspace lifecycle, status/doctor, profile and contract configuration, direct Beads guidance, and generated workspace artifacts aligned. Verify tests, vet, task gates, smoke tests, and documentation cleanup.
close_reason: Retired workflow CLI surfaces, removed review/TUI internals, aligned docs and generated artifacts, and passed verification.

title: Define starter performance budgets and load verification
description: Turn later scalability claims into measurable budgets after the runnable v0.1.0 starter is accepted.
design: Define representative API and Web scenarios, startup and readiness budgets, latency and throughput targets, resource ceilings, database pool behavior, test data, warmup, repeatability, and failure thresholds without inventing product-domain workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Reviewed budgets and a repeatable local or disposable-environment load suite report baseline results and regressions; claims state hardware and test assumptions; failures are actionable and do not become a v0.1.0 release blocker retroactively.
notes: Deferred P3 quality follow-up outside smt-4xf.

title: Implement the metrics and tracing observability module
description: Add production metrics and distributed tracing after the base starter and safe module extension path are accepted.
design: Build on structured logs, request IDs, health, and readiness from v0.1.0. Define OpenTelemetry-compatible API and Web instrumentation, local collector behavior, propagation, sampling, redaction, verification, and optional repository placement through the module contract.
acceptance_criteria: The module can be planned and added safely through the accepted extension workflow; metrics and traces correlate without exposing credentials or sensitive payloads; disabled and partial-topology behavior is tested; base starters remain usable without it.
notes: Deferred P3 capability; blocked by the extension vertical slice rather than the first epic.

title: Add SBOM signing and release attestations
description: Extend the practical v0.1.0 security baseline with verifiable release and image provenance in a later milestone.
design: Select reviewed tools and define SBOM formats, archive and image coverage, signing identity, keyless or key-managed trust, attestations, verification commands, failure policy, and compatibility with the existing tag-triggered release pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Release artifacts and applicable generated images have reproducible SBOMs, signatures, attestations, and documented verification; secrets are not persisted; rollout and recovery are tested. This task does not block v0.1.0.
notes: Deferred P3 supply-chain follow-up.

title: Design safe generated-workspace upgrades
description: Define an explicit future upgrade path for one-shot generated workspaces without allowing SMT to overwrite user-owned application code.
design: Start only after v0.1.0 establishes stable provenance. Design version discovery, unchanged-file ownership checks, dry-run, conflicts, migrations, backups or recovery guidance, and exact no-op behavior. Do not add implicit regeneration to smt apply.
acceptance_criteria: An approved design defines compatibility inputs, ownership boundaries, conflict behavior, failure recovery, testing, and whether a separate command is justified; no implementation begins under the first epic.
notes: Deferred P3 follow-up outside smt-4xf.

title: Design provider-specific remote CI generation
description: Evaluate generated GitHub and GitLab workflows only after the provider-neutral local verification contract is released.
design: Use repository-local Taskfiles as the stable interface. Compare per-repository and root integration workflows, provider authentication boundaries, shared-template ownership, version pinning, pull-request permissions, secret handling, and failure reporting. Do not place workflow generation in v0.1.0.
acceptance_criteria: An approved decision records provider scope, generated files, permissions, local-command reuse, security boundaries, compatibility, and rollout; no remote workflow is claimed by the first epic.
notes: Deferred P3 follow-up outside smt-4xf.

title: Implement smt extend from module specifications
description: After the P0 module restructure is accepted, add a safe command that applies a reviewed built-in module specification to an existing SMT workspace. The first vertical slice is a scaffold-only E2E submodule.
design: Expose smt extend MODULE with dry-run, confirmation, and yes modes. Require a clean aligned active Beads branch; plan all changes before mutation; validate catalog dependencies and collisions; add the child repository, module metadata, scope, gitlink, agent manifest, and exact commits; support exact-state no-op and safe resume; never auto-rollback published state or create providers. Keep remote registries and arbitrary local specs out of the first release.
acceptance_criteria: After smt-4xf is complete, the E2E module can be planned and added safely to a real applied workspace; dry-run mutates nothing; configured lifecycle commands include it; complete reruns are no-ops; conflicting partial state is rejected without mutation; automated and human E2E gates pass.
notes: P3 and deferred until after 2026-08-24. User explicitly requested that extend be done later.
